name: Hold Your Breath
summary: Toronto, 3:40 AM. They can't see you, but they can hear you. Hold Your Breath is a first-person stealth horror game in which blind creatures hunt the empty city streets by sound, including the sound your microphone picks up, so you have to move quietly and hold your breath to reach the tower. The microphone is optional. Your microphone never leaves your device. Nothing is recorded, kept or sent.
